limitation: Exact version/body coverage, not scientific acceptance. Changed older versions are explicit gaps; private handoffs and unpublished extensions are excluded.
identity_normalization: Resolve every requested commit with git rev-parse and deduplicate before checking; full unique publication count, no short/full alias inflation.

prior_count_correction_preserved.reason: Same publication supplied via already-normalized full identity plus short alias; duplicate rows are byte-identical. No source/body/query result dropped. Historical receipt remains in Git.
